parameters.wind_unit: wind_speed_ms (m/s), cross-checked against km/h when present

G0-2_level3_share.rule: 受体节点 Level 3 占比 ≥ 1.0%

G0-3_max_gap.rule: 受体节点最长连续缺失 ≤ 24 小时（源区节点的缺口不影响标签，仅披露）

G0-4_distribution_drift.rule: 受体节点 train 与 test 的 Level 3 占比差异 ≤ 3 倍

notes: 测试集覆盖 2026 年 8–10 月的强跨境烟霾过程（KL 单月 Level 3 占比达 47%–51%，PM2.5 p95 = 151.8 µg/m³），因此 High-Risk Recall 具有真实事件支撑。
空气质量为 CAMS 0.4° 模式产品，非地面实测；报告须声明。
同格点候选点位已归并为单一节点，见 docs/node_discovery.json。

spatial_training_diagnostics.scope: train target rows; target labels are excluded
spatial_training_diagnostics.candidate_rule: Within hard radius; KL and Peninsula form one group, other named regions are separate
spatial_training_diagnostics.coordinate_basis: Available sampling coordinates; exact atmospheric-model cell centres are not verified.

definitions.positive_weight_neighbor_count: Number of QC-valid source weights > minimum_weight_ms
definitions.zero_weight: All target rows without a positive usable weight, including unavailable inputs. The same unfiltered denominator is used for legacy and current comparisons.
definitions.unavailable_inputs: A geometric source exists but no candidate has finite, QC-valid wind and PM2.5.
definitions.weight_concentration: Maximum normalized weight; values near 1 imply one-source dominance

limitations: The fixed near-field scale and sensitivity values are evaluated on training rows only.
Directional weights are associations and do not establish physical transport or travel times.

legacy_spatial_training_diagnostics.scope: train target rows; target labels are excluded
legacy_spatial_training_diagnostics.candidate_rule: Distance only, no hard radius (legacy baseline)
legacy_spatial_training_diagnostics.coordinate_basis: Available sampling coordinates; exact atmospheric-model cell centres are not verified.

definitions.positive_weight_neighbor_count: Number of QC-valid source weights > minimum_weight_ms
definitions.zero_weight: All target rows without a positive usable weight, including unavailable inputs. The same unfiltered denominator is used for legacy and current comparisons.
definitions.unavailable_inputs: A geometric source exists but no candidate has finite, QC-valid wind and PM2.5.
definitions.weight_concentration: Maximum normalized weight; values near 1 imply one-source dominance

limitations: The fixed near-field scale and sensitivity values are evaluated on training rows only.
Directional weights are associations and do not establish physical transport or travel times.

far_field_background.definition: Unweighted mean across QC-valid Sumatra and Borneo PM2.5 cells each hour; strictly past rolling windows require every hour in the same split.
far_field_background.interpretation: Regional background, without a wind weight or assumed travel time.

spatial_column_checks.scope: train-only; equality compares values and null positions

limitations: CAMS grid estimates, not ground observations; weather archive is retrospective.
The legacy 15 km calculation is included as a coverage comparison only.
Original interpolated values and fitted baselines remain upstream-owned.
Use eligibility flags; refit upstream transforms within each CV/LOSO fold.
Weights encode a directional association, not travel time or source attribution.
